explanation: A warning against judging others with a harsh or unfair attitude, since one will be judged by the same standard.
A tiny piece of wood or stone stuck in the eye causing pain; used metaphorically for small faults in others compared to one's own major flaws.
A large object, often a log, symbolizing serious character flaws or sins that one has in their own life.
The act of receiving something; used to describe how God gives to those who ask for help and guidance.
A small hole or opening, often referring to the narrow gate that leads to life through a demanding path of righteousness.
A large and easy passage; used to describe the wide gate that leads to destruction because many choose this easy way.
A sign of quality or character; a person's actions reveal their true nature, so one knows the tree by its fruit.
Describes those who have righteous hearts and act in accordance with God's will, leading to good deeds.
A term for those who live according to their own will without God; their actions are bad because the source is corrupt.
A dwelling or foundation; used metaphorically about a life built on God's word, which withstands the storms and trials of existence.
